task.title: Fix pre-existing wasm panic in count_stepper blur-commit path
task.description: Filed from P6-117 (2026-08-10). While building a deterministic e2e for the stale-stepper-id window, the implementing agent reliably reproduced a wasm panic in count_stepper.rs's stray-focusout blur-commit machinery (~:99/:416) — holding the post-undo collection_view refetch open and interacting with the stepper in that window panics the page. A/B-verified via git stash: reproduces identically on unmodified main, so it predates P6-117 and is unrelated to its changes. The repro recipe (page.route holding the refetch open) is documented in specs/app-ui.md's P6-117 Findings entry. Reachable in principle by real slow-network interaction; investigate with the systematic-debugging skill. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.
